notes.title: 🗣️ Voices Update In my Skull 🎙️
notes.content: [p]The world of [i]Skull’s Impossible Quest[/i] just got a whole lot louder… and a whole lot more alive (well, undead). Every line of dialogue in the game now features fully voiced characters, bringing more personality, menace, and absurdity to your adventure![/p][h3][b]What’s New[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🎭 Fully Voiced Characters[/b] – All major characters now have unique, high-quality voice acting powered by our custom ElevenLabs voice design.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🦴 The Skull[/b] – Our fearless hero now speaks with a sharp wit, dry humor, and the occasional sarcastic jab at his foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]👹 Imp Companion[/b] – Your mischievous sidekick delivers fast-talking banter, impish taunts, and the occasional helpful tip (whether you want it or not).[/p][/*][*][p][b]🪦 The Council[/b] – Three eerie undead voices speaking in unison, offering cryptic advice… or thinly veiled threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🍖 Fatty Boss[/b] – Gluttony has a voice, and it’s loud, grotesque, and disturbingly proud of it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]👑 Skeleton King[/b] – A regal, commanding tone echoing through his ancient hall of pillars.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎩 Ghoul Boss[/b] – Smooth, sinister, and theatrical—like a haunted gentleman hosting your demise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]❄️ Zombie Viking Boss[/b] – Cold as the mountains he calls home, with the fury of an ancient war chief returned from the grave.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Why This Matters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Deeper immersion in the story[/p][/*][*][p]More memorable and distinct villains[/p][/*][*][p]Funnier, sharper banter between characters[/p][/*][*][p]Combat encounters that [i]sound[/i] as epic as they feel[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]How to Experience the New Voices[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Update your game to the latest version[/p][/*][*][p]Start a new adventure [b]or[/b] load your current save[/p][/*][*][p]Turn up the volume, and let the voices guide… or haunt you[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Skull's Impossible Quest in Early Access!
notes.content:
Ever spend a ton of your free time working on a labor of love? A passion project that you feel compelled to do? After getting feedback from the community and other game developers, I set to work 6 hours a week on this project.  I started with a simple concept. I wanted to have a game that was easy to learn and that you could play intuitively.  I was inspired by rogue like games I had played in the past, and wanted something slightly different.  I wanted a game that would be playable with bizarre controls, and could be expanded upon in the future.  I wanted something that would be light hearted and funny. I wanted to make something that I loved working on, and that people would love playing.  I wanted it to be pun-tastic!  I wanted something that was unique, and that I could call my own. The result of that effort is a game that I am proud to say that I have been working on for the past year.  It's called "Skull's Impossible Quest" and it's available now in Early Access!

Purchase now to support the effort. Hit the community button in game to give me feedback on new features!

notes.title: Live Stream Demo / AMA / Dev
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39002554/174518a439e15616363d64cfaddb38c50e26cc48.png[/img]
Join us in playing, developing, and answering questions about Skull’s Impossible Quest. It is a physics-based hack and slash where you can fight your way through enemies and solve puzzles along the way! Shortly after the festival we plan to release to early access while I add features to the game! Currently there is a robust dialog system and 12 rich levels to play. The demo contains much of the first level’s content.

Please try the demo and Wishlist the game!
